The most INSANE anime sequel season ever? Bleach TYBW's FINAL arc, Re:Zero Season 4's Recapture Arc, Mushoku Tensei Season 3, and Saga of Tanya the Evil II — back after NINE years! This is the full breakdown of all 11 returning anime sequels and which ones will define the season.
From Grand Blue's international chaos to 100 Girlfriends' seventeen-girlfriend key visual, and the ending of Bleach twenty years in the making — every returning heavyweight of the Summer 2026 season, ranked, hyped, and fraud-watched.
